name: Statistic
usage: KPI rows at the top of dashboards, key numbers of a project or a period, figures next to a chart

props.name: label
props.description: What the number is, in sentence case and without a trailing colon, such as "Monthly revenue".

props.name: value
props.description: The value. `null` shows a dash (no data).

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is written; `auto` is in full below 10,000 and compact from there on (1,284 · 12.9K).

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the value, in the same style, such as a currency symbol.

props.name: suffix
props.description: A unit after the value, smaller and in the secondary text color, such as "items" or "ms".

props.name: delta
props.description:
The change compared with an earlier period: `{ value, period, format?, goodWhen? }`. It is shown with an
arrow and a sign (+12.5%), never by color alone; its color is the success color when the change is good,
the danger color when it is bad, and the secondary text color with `goodWhen: 'none'` or no change.

props.name: trend
props.description:
Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a Sparkline under the value (about 12 points): the history in the
de-emphasis color, the current value as an accent dot.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows a skeleton in place of the value (and of the change and trend, when given) while the data loads; the
size does not change when the data arrives.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the value: `md` (24 px) for KPI rows, `lg` (32 px) for the main figure of an area.

types.name: ValueFormat
types.summary:
How a value is written.
- `'auto'`: in full below 10,000, compact from 10,000 on (1,284 · 12.9K · 4.2M).
- `'number'`: always in full, with grouping separators.
- `'compact'`: always compact.
- `'percent'`: the value is a ratio (0.125 → 12.5%).
- a function: your own formatting (units, currencies).

types.name: StatisticDelta
types.summary: The change of a Statistic compared with an earlier period.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The change. With the default `format` it is a ratio: 0.125 is shown as +12.5%.

fields.name: format
fields.description:
How the change is written. A function receives the absolute value of the change; the sign and the arrow are
added.

fields.name: period
fields.description: The period it is compared with, such as "vs last month".

fields.name: goodWhen
fields.description:
Which direction is good: `up` (revenue), `down` (errors, response time) or `none` (neither, shown in the
secondary text color).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
A label, a value, its change compared with an earlier period and a trend of the last 12 periods. The tile has
no background of its own: place it in a Panel.

examples.name: KpiRow
examples.title: KPI row
examples.description:
Put several tiles in a Grid. Large values are compact (12.9K); `prefix` and `suffix` add a currency or a unit.
When a lower value is better, set `goodWhen: 'down'`: a decrease is then shown in the success color.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Changes and sizes
examples.description:
`goodWhen: 'none'` keeps the change in the secondary text color when neither direction is better; no change
shows a flat arrow. An absolute change uses its own `format`. `size="lg"` is for the main figure of an area.

examples.name: States
examples.title: Loading and no data
examples.description:
While `loading`, skeletons take the place of the value, the change and the trend, and appear after 200 ms; the
tile keeps its size when the data arrives. A `null` value shows a dash.
